prompt: A CFO asks why the architect presents total cost of ownership separately from return on investment in the AI business case. What does the learning content say?

options.text: TCO and ROI answer very different questions, and separating them makes evaluations sharper and easier to communicate
TCO is relevant for custom models and Foundry workloads, so it is omitted from business cases for Copilot Studio agents
ROI already includes the lifecycle costs of development, deployment, and operations, so TCO is a redundant figure
TCO replaces ROI once the solution is in production, because the benefits are then tracked by the Savings calculator

explanation: TCO und ROI stehen in jedem Business Case nebeneinander, beantworten aber sehr unterschiedliche Fragen; klare Trennung macht Bewertungen schärfer, belastbarer und kommunizierbarer. TCO umfasst alle Kosten über den Lebenszyklus.

source.title: Evaluate ROI criteria for AI-powered solutions
source.quote: When you separate them clearly, your AI evaluations become sharper, more defensible, and far easier to communicate to leadership.

prompt: Match each cost item from an AI business case to the TCO category it belongs to according to the learning content.

left.text: Prompt engineering and agent design and testing
Model retraining and prompt library maintenance
Retiring outdated models and migrating to new architectures

explanation: Development (Datenvorbereitung, Prompt Engineering, Design/Test, Integration), Deployment (Infrastruktur, Lizenzen, Security-Setup, API-Nutzung), Operational (Monitoring, Retraining, Prompt-Library-Pflege, Support, Training), Change Management (Skilling, Rollout, Prozessredesign), Decommissioning (Modelle stilllegen, Migration).

source.title: Evaluate ROI criteria for AI-powered solutions

prompt: A program manager wants to quantify productivity gains of a Copilot Studio agent with real usage data rather than estimates. Which metrics does the learning content say Copilot Studio ROI analytics provides?

options.text: Usage metrics such as sessions and active users, automation metrics such as completion rate, cost savings such as time saved, and quality metrics
Net present value, payback period, and cost-benefit ratio, computed automatically from license invoices, session counts, and the agent's connector usage
Session counts and session duration, while savings and quality must be estimated in a separate finance tool outside Copilot Studio
GPU utilization, token throughput, model drift indicators, and connector latency, aggregated per environment in the admin center

explanation: ROI Analytics liefert Usage (Sessions, aktive Nutzer, Dauer), Automation (Completion, Abandonment, Task Success), Cost Savings (geschätzte Zeit- und Kostenersparnis, weniger manuelle Arbeit) und Quality (Feedback, Fehlerrate, Eskalationen). NPV und Payback berechnet der Architekt im Bewertungsframework.

source.title: Evaluate ROI criteria for AI-powered solutions
source.quote: These metrics help quantify both productivity gains and operational efficiency.

prompt: An analyst builds the ROI model for an email-triage agent: 6 minutes saved per run, 20,000 successful runs per month, and a labor rate of 60 dollars per hour. The analyst also counts runs that were abandoned mid-way. Which correction does the learning content require?

options.text: Count only successful, resolved runs; the model yields 120,000 dollars of monthly savings for the 20,000 runs
Count every run including abandoned ones, because each invocation consumes labor time that the agent replaces
Replace minutes saved with average session duration, because time saved per run cannot be measured directly
Use the vendor's published productivity benchmark instead of internal telemetry to calibrate the minutes saved

explanation: Inputs: Zeitersparnis je Run, erfolgreiche Runs im Zeitraum (nur gelöste Runs zählen), vollständig belasteter Stundensatz. Beispiel: 6 Minuten × 20.000 Runs × 60 $/h = 120.000 $ monatlich.

source.title: Create ROI analysis for a proposed AI solution
source.quote: Successful runs in period (only resolved runs count).

topic: Savings per run vs per tool
prompt: An agent uses four tools with very different time impacts: a lookup tool saves seconds, a document-generation tool saves twenty minutes. Which Savings configuration does the learning content recommend?

options.text: Savings per tool, which gives a granular estimate when an agent uses multiple tools with different impacts
Savings per run, which is designed for agents with many heterogeneous tools and a variable run path
No savings tracking, because admins can disable money-based savings and time savings are not convertible into currency later
Session duration from Analytics, because the Savings panel is unable to capture tool-level time differences

explanation: Savings per run eignet sich bei vorhersehbarem Ablauf; Savings per tool liefert granulare Schätzungen, wenn ein Agent mehrere Tools mit unterschiedlichem Impact nutzt. Deaktiviert der Admin geldbasierte Savings, wird Zeit getrackt und extern in Währung umgerechnet.

source.title: Create ROI analysis for a proposed AI solution
source.quote: Savings per tool (granular estimate when an agent uses multiple tools with different impacts).

prompt: An AI solution delivers an annual benefit of 486,000 dollars against a year-one TCO of 300,000 dollars. Using the formulas in the learning content, which statement is correct?

options.text: Net benefit is 186,000 dollars and ROI is about 62 percent
Net benefit is 486,000 dollars and ROI is about 162 percent
ROI is 38 percent because TCO is divided by benefit
ROI is undefined until the GPU hours consumed are known

explanation: Net_Benefit = Annual_Benefit − Annual_TCO = 186.000 $; ROI % = Net_Benefit / Annual_TCO × 100 ≈ 62 %. Payback (Monate) = einmalige Kosten / monatlicher Nettonutzen. Das ist genau das Worked Example der Lerninhalte.

prompt: Stakeholders challenge a single-point ROI estimate. Which practice from the learning content should the architect add to the executive summary?

options.text: Optimistic, expected, and conservative cases that vary adoption rate, minutes saved per run, labor rates, and quality effects
A single best-case figure backed by a vendor whitepaper and the field studies on knowledge worker productivity
A decision to skip the eight-week pilot and scale immediately, so that uncertainty is resolved by production data
A breakdown of licensing by SKU and consumption tier, since licensing is the cost component with the widest range in the first year

explanation: Sensitivity Bands: optimistisch/erwartet/konservativ durch Variation von Adoptionsrate, Minuten je Run, Stundensätzen und Qualitäts-/Rework-Effekten. So sehen Stakeholder Upside und Risiko; eigene Telemetrie bleibt maßgeblich.

prompt: Match each business situation to the sourcing path recommended in the learning content.

Processes are standardized, AI maturity is low, and rapid deployment with vendor support matters most
The base model performs well but needs enterprise-specific knowledge via grounding data, connectors, or plugins

prompt: Arrange these steps of the build-buy-extend decision framework in the order given by the learning content.

items.text: Define business requirements and business processes
Estimate TCO across the five cost domains
Score each option on a weighted model and select the best value-to-cost ratio

prompt: An application uses an LLM, an SLM, and a fine-tuned model behind separate endpoints, and developers struggle with integration complexity. What does the Azure AI Foundry model router provide according to the learning content?

options.text: A single unified endpoint that selects the best model per request based on routing rules, performance criteria, and constraints
A fine-tuning service that merges the three models into one distilled model with a single deployment and endpoint
A caching layer that stores prior responses so that models are called less often and integration code can be simplified
A licensing broker that selects the cheapest vendor contract per request and consolidates billing across the three model providers

explanation: Der Model Router bietet einen einheitlichen Endpunkt für mehrere Modelle, intelligentes Routing nach Task-Typ, Fähigkeiten, Kosten, Latenz und eigenen Regeln sowie zentrale Governance (Versionierung, Monitoring, Analytics, Safety).

source.title: Implement a model router to intelligently route requests to the most suitable model

prompt: Match each routing need to the rule type the learning content describes for Azure AI Foundry.

left.text: Send every classification request to an SLM
Split traffic between two models for an A/B test and gradual rollout
Route to a backup model automatically if the primary fails
Send specific traffic to an experimental version while most goes to the latest stable one

explanation: Static Rules („If task = classification → use SLM“), Weighted Routing (Traffic-Verteilung, A/B, Rollout), Fallback Routing (Backup bei Ausfall), Version-Based Routing (stabil vs. experimentell).

source.title: Implement a model router to intelligently route requests to the most suitable model
source.quote: Useful for A/B testing and gradual rollout

prompt: A routing workshop defines complexity tiers for requests. Which mapping matches the learning content?

options.text: Simple tasks to an SLM, moderate tasks to a fine-tuned model, complex tasks to an LLM
Simple tasks to an LLM, moderate tasks to an SLM, complex tasks to a fine-tuned model
Simple tasks to the LLM, moderate tasks to an SLM, complex tasks to a reasoning model
Simple tasks to a fine-tuned model, moderate tasks to an LLM, complex tasks to an SLM

explanation: Routing-Kriterium Komplexität: Simple → SLM, Moderate → Fine-tuned Model, Complex → LLM. Ziel: Kosten senken bei gleichbleibender Performance.

prompt: Which three ROI categories does the module summary in the learning content say AI solutions must be assessed across?

options.text: Financial (hard value), strategic or intangible (soft value), and time-based indicators
Licensing (fixed), infrastructure (variable), staffing (recurring), and change management costs
Accuracy, latency, and token efficiency, measured per release
Build, buy, and extend, scored on a weighted value-to-cost model

explanation: Die Zusammenfassung nennt drei Kategorien: Financial (quantifizierbar: Einsparungen, Umsatz), Strategic/Intangible (Kundenzufriedenheit, Produktivität, Compliance) und Time-based (frühe Indikatoren wie schnellere Workflows).

source.title: Summary (Evaluate costs and benefits of AI solutions)
source.quote: ROI for AI solutions must be assessed across three categories: financial (hard value), strategic/intangible (soft value), and time-based indicators.
